title: Dragonfly Field Lab: a browser game on how a Titan lander identifies organic molecules
description: A free, browser-based game built around NASA's Dragonfly mission to Titan. Students follow the mission's route from the Ahmakiq Undae dune field to Selk crater and identify fifteen surface samples. The astronomy edition (astronomy.html) uses the mass spectrometer only; the organic chemistry edition (index.html) adds 1H NMR, 13C NMR and infrared spectra, labelled as instruments the real craft does not carry.
